name: cover_each_payment
description: Plain answers: a range of guest counts is run as two cases (43,000 and 54,500 in total), the payments, the monthly surplus and the fund balance come from modules, and the 200-guest shortfall at the second payment (5,250) is shown.
lines: Can I cover each wedding payment? The wedding is on 12 June 2027 and I expect between 150 and 200 guests, at 230 each for dinner. Costs that do not depend on guests: 5,000 for extras, 2,000 for the DJ and 1,500 for the bar. The first payment is 6,000, due in 21 days, and it counts towards the total. The second is half of what remains, due 30 days before the wedding, and the third is the other half, due 14 days before. I take home 10,000 a month and spend about 5,000 a month. I have 10,000 saved for the wedding. My families will give 20,000 on 29 May 2027.
